summary: Bootstrap binds 'W' key (options.keybind) via mp.add_key_binding and registers 'file-loaded' event to auto-set times
MainPage is the UI state machine root; c/1/2/o/p/e/ESC navigate to crop/settime/options/preview/encode/idle states
MainPage.encode validates startTime/endTime (non-negative, start<end) before calling encode(); nil region is allowed
keybind is bound at startup; changing options.keybind via IPC after load does not update the key binding
